prompt: A circle has radius $6$. What is the area of a sector with a central angle of $60°$?
hint: Find the fraction of the circle, then take that fraction of the area.

hints.text: Find the fraction of the circle, then take that fraction of the area.

learningObjective: Compute a sector area as a fraction of the circle area.
explanation: The fraction of the circle is $\dfrac{60}{360} = \dfrac{1}{6}$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Sector versus arc
steps: A sector is a pie slice — a two-dimensional region measured in square units.
An arc is just the curved edge — a one-dimensional length.
Here the arc would be $\tfrac{1}{6}(12\pi) = 2\pi$, which is choice A. Both appear among the choices deliberately.
